task.intent: Retrieve NOAA GML provider-reported global annual atmospheric CH4 increments and uncertainties for 2023 through 2025.
task.claim_ceiling: Provider-reported NOAA GML global annual atmospheric CH4 increments and stated uncertainties for the requested years only; no emissions estimate, source attribution, causal explanation, source authentication, or scientific adjudication.

receipt.source_attribution: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Trends in Atmospheric Methane, global annual increase table.
source_caveats: NOAA may revise its latest year after reference-gas recalibration and quality-control procedures; earlier rows can also change.
Annual increase sums methane added to and removed from the atmosphere; it is not an emissions inventory or source attribution.
Provider-reported values and uncertainty are returned without independent scientific validation.
non_claims: The lookup does not estimate emissions, attribute changes to a source, explain causes, or establish a scientific conclusion.
The response digest binds received bytes but does not independently authenticate NOAA or certify the data.
The response body is not retained; this is one captured invocation, not evidence of repeatability.
receipt.claim_ceiling: Selected provider-reported NOAA GML global annual atmospheric methane mole-fraction increments and stated uncertainties only. The result is not an emissions estimate, source attribution, causal explanation, or scientific adjudication.
